t: This is the site of the New Cross Empire, in Lewisham, a former theatre and cinema. It was designed by Frank Matcham, the English architect who specialised in theatres and music halls. Working mostly for Moss Empires, he designed the Hackney Empire, Shepherd's Bush Empire, the Coliseum and the Palladium, among many others. Over forty years he was responsible for more than ninety theatres. This was one of the Empires in that family of variety houses, built for an age when an evening out meant a night at the music hall.
